summary: Part 3 (13:45 to 19:39) of the 11.0 Dashboard (KAMs) video walks through the Supply dashboard's KAM tab, sidebar section by section, with the Sherin KAM tab selected throughout: Sellers (Semi-active, Buybox closed, Slowing down), Orders, On time (Performance, Backlog, Stuck orders, Delivery companies, Manual update), Fulfillment, Quality (Defect rate, Top offenders), Claims management (Days to solve, Claims coverage, Refund policy, Invalid claims). Cancellation and Sellers connections are narrated only; no frame in this part shows them. All 40 frames listed in the pack were opened. Several screen numbers are cut off or unreadable and are listed under unclear.

terms.meaning: The KAM tab filters the dashboard to one KAM's book of sellers (screen tabs All, Pepe, Yahia, Sherin, Momen, Samaa, Unassigned). The expansion 'key account manager' is not shown on screen or in this part's narration. Implied: key account manager.
The set of sellers assigned to the KAM. Lists such as Buybox closed are limited to it.
A seller with between 1 and 29 orders so far this month; the quick-win list.
Chart legend: a seller with 30 or more orders (screen: 'Active sellers (>=30 orders)').
An active seller whose buybox has been closed for more than 3 days.
An active-last-month seller who is behind its own pace this month (month-to-date vs same days last month).
Slowing down column giving the percentage change of this month to date against the same days last month. The narrator calls this column the PACE column.
Orders shown per period on the Orders page.
GMV per period, in thousands of AED, shown on the Orders page.
Split button: Saudi Arabia against the rest of the markets (legend 'SA' and 'Excl. SA (AE / ZA / other)').
Split button. The narrator describes it only as direct against fulfilled by Revibe; the screen shows the label without a definition.
Revibe's delivery promise: delivery within 5 working days in SA; shipment within 2 business days elsewhere.
Orders received in a period, shown by the stage they are at today.
Orders still not delivered; the pink line accumulates them.
Backlog stages seen on screen for orders not yet shipped.
The oldest unshipped orders in the KAM's book (narration).
An order is old once it reaches the OLD threshold; the slider is at >=6d on screen, and the narrator says six days matches the business operations definition.
Orders shipped more than three days ago and not yet marked delivered.
A courier the sellers use (for example DHL, SMSA Express, Aramex, UPS).
Column header on Delivery companies. The narrator describes it as the share marked delivered; under 70% is red (narrated, not seen on screen).
A status set by hand, not by the courier feed. 100% manual means no API integration for that status.
Switch on Delivery companies that shows each courier month by month (screen label 'Evol.').
Share of the seller's orders fulfilled by Revibe, where Revibe ships the order instead of the seller.
Claims filed within 30 or 90 days of the order, shown as a rate on the Defect rate chart. Implied: the rate is claims divided by orders (consistent with the Top offenders contribution definition).
Claim rate counting every claim filed so far; still growing, so not comparable month to month.
A seller's own claims divided by the portfolio's orders; the column adds up to the portfolio rate.
Average number of days the sellers take to resolve a claim. Lower is better.
Share of claims raised in a period that are now closed; open claims are red.
The policy clock running on open returns for the sellers, from Daily.
24 weekday hours on the Dubai calendar day; Saturday and Sunday never accrue.
On the clock is the total of open returns with a seller timer (41); moving (28) is accruing weekday hours; stopped (13) is banked hours frozen until the timer restarts.
Refund-chart markers: a warning icon on warning days, and a red icon once the policy is applied; read from the config table.
Returns followed through three verdicts: rejected by the seller, confirmed invalid by a Revibe agent, confirmed by the Revibe lab.
The two Revibe review stages in invalid claims; the lab is the last word.
Excluded from both ends of the invalid-claims funnel.
Percentage of orders canceled per period (narrated only).
How often each seller opens the seller portal; each cell counts the card opens (narrated only). Sidebar label is 'Sellers connections'.
